note: props carries every profile and scalar of the run that the equilibrium, the prescribed density, the composition and the heating settle before the plasma is solved, under the name the simulator gives it, together with the flux surfaces, the heating delivered to each species, the boundary condition and the grids. It never carries the shape as a number, a transport coefficient or a temperature. The confinement time is the stored energy inside the boundary over the heating delivered inside it, integrated the same way from every submission's profiles.
